clips.title: The story
paras: In Orgrimmar's Valley of Strength, Horde champions gather in the Hall of Legends. Behind its guarded entrance, proven officers confer over battle plans and arm themselves with weapons and armor from conflicts across Azeroth and beyond.

Horde officers gather in the Hall of Legends, off the Valley of Strength's busy avenues. Beyond its guarded entrance, strategists and delegates from across the faction confer over maps of contested lands and the military standing of both factions. Among them are Chieftain Earthbind of Thunder Bluff, Blood Guard Hini'wana of the Darkspear, and Advisor Willington of the Undercity. Only warriors who have reached the rank of Stone Guard or higher may enter and claim the arms and spoils kept within.

The Hall of Legends holds armories stocked with battle-tested wargear for proven Horde officers. For those rising through the military ranks, its weapons and armor mark honor, martial skill, and victory hard won.
